scope: Independent, out-of-manuscript, two-closure falsification experiment; neither closure is a literal replay of pinned full EGC model.

historical_evidence_source.use: Motivation only; never pooled or treated as an independent replication.

hypothesis: A local q-dependent allele-selection edge can increase the reversed-minus-aligned risk differential most where allele-linked recruitment repairs trait-allele mismatch weakly; test whether the direction carries from an aggregate-feedback analogue to an explicitly partner-encounter-limited closure.

closure_A.name: aggregate_support_analogue
closure_A.note: Analogue of original support map, NOT the original pinned life cycle: binary trait and independent binomial sampling.

closure_B.name: partner_encounter_and_mating_limited
closure_B.note: Non-equivalent partner-mediated interaction; q represents realized encounter fraction, not aggregate ecological support.

update_order: closure interaction and optional partner state
shared_life_cycle.finite_population_caveat: Min population=1; loss endpoint is absence of a realized high-trait phenotype, not population extinction. First passage can recover.

fixed_factorial.interpretation: h=0.75 means weaker genotype-linked mismatch repair than h=0.25; allele selection s=1 uses original functional multiplier, s=0 is its no-selection comparator.

replication.pairing: AA/RR, closure, strength and repair share key seed. Their draw sequences can diverge; analyze block-level paired key contrasts.

primary_endpoint.name: first_realized_all_patch_high_trait_loss
primary_endpoint.definition: first t>=1 with high-trait binomial count==0 in all four patches, regardless of later reappearance
primary_endpoint.censoring: not lost by t40 => right censored at t40; no exclusion

secondary_endpoint.name: modeled_compatible_interaction_opportunity
secondary_endpoint.definition: generation-40 sum(N_j * m_j * q_j)/sum(N_j); not observed seed set and not proof of actual mating compatibility

primary_estimand.preregistered_direction: D>0 in both closures, i.e. local selection's AA-relative advantage is stronger when recruitment mismatch repair is weaker
primary_estimand.criterion: both closure-specific six-block t-based 95% intervals for D exclude zero on positive side AND point estimates each exceed 0.02 absolute risk units; no data-driven domain choice
primary_estimand.negative_interpretation: failure in either closure means cross-closure directional portability not established; negative D is sign reversal, crossing zero is unresolved; no relabeling
primary_estimand.precision: six master seed blocks are independent inference units; also report raw per-cell risks and full denominators

secondary_prediction.estimand: within closure for each preregistered s/h cell, AUC for future loss by generation 40 among trajectories with no first loss through generation 10; report ΔAUC with six-block uncertainty, and report any zero-event/zero-control blocks without replacement
secondary_prediction.interpretation: exploratory, structurally favorable to all-patch-loss endpoint; does NOT validate a novel natural warning rule

stop_rules: Never inspect trait-loss outputs before the protocol-only freeze commit is recorded; code implementation must use a parent commit containing this immutable protocol file.
Never change the fixed initialization, parameter values, selection and repair strengths, master seed list, replication, horizon or endpoint based on outcomes.
No change of sign rule, one-sided data-screening, condition selection, alternate seed family, sequential sample-size increase or posthoc redefining binary loss.
No natural validation claim; do not pool old EGC outputs with these two new analogues.
If result is all-events, no-events, all early-events, or incompatible state/operator, report infeasible and stop rather than tune.
Interpret any positive result as limited to the two explicit model closures and listed seed families.
